description: French fiscal horsepower (puissance administrative, Code des impositions sur les biens et services, CIBS art. L. 421-14 to L. 421-22). Default regime (cars M1 first registered in France from 2021-01-01, parameters in CIBS art. A. 421-3 to D. 421-11): PA = 1.80 x (PM/100)^2 + 3.87 x (PM/100) + 1.34 with PM = max net engine power in kW. Legacy regime (CIBS art. L. 421-15: cars first registered in France between 1998-07-01 and 2021-01-01, except types approved or modified from 2019-11-01, keep the formula of the former legislation, now in CIBS art. A. 421-12 to A. 421-23): PA = CO2/45 + (PM/40)^1.6. Result rounded to the nearest unit, 0.5 counted as 1. Returns: {regime, cv_raw, cv_fiscaux}.

co2_g_km.description: CO2 g/km (NEDC), required only for the cibs_l421_15_1998_2020 regime

power_kw.description: Max net engine power in kW (PM, field P.2 of the registration certificate)

regime.description: cibs_from_2021 = general case (cars first registered in France from 1 January 2021); cibs_l421_15_1998_2020 = cars first registered in France between 1 July 1998 and 1 January 2021 whose type was approved before 1 November 2019 (CIBS art. L. 421-15). Legacy aliases accepted: art_1008_II, art_1008_III_1998_2020

name: calculate_puissance_fiscale

formula.description: Human-readable formula or method used (e.g. "I=P·r·t", "Magnus formula").

reference_url.description: Link to a calcul2 page documenting the calculation in detail.

result.description: Computed result. Object whose fields depend on the tool (e.g. {tax, marginal_rate, brackets} for tax tools, {volume_l, gallons} for volume tools).

source.description: Authoritative source for the rule or formula (e.g. "Article 197 CGI", "NF DTU 21").

title: Calculate Puissance Fiscale
